profile.headline: SWE @ PayPal | CS @ UIUC
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer at PayPal with an interest in backend development, distributed system, cloud computing, deep learning, and their real-world applications.

I got my Master's degree at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (UIUC) and had two internship experiences previously. At Micron Technology, I redesigned an algorithm for tracking and analyzing abnormal products. This update resolved three critical logic issues that had resulted in missing data and improved the run time by 86%. At Cathay Financial Holdings, I led a team to develop a full-stack cloud-native application on Google Cloud Platform. This project demonstrated the feasibility of integrating an open-source tool to optimize the company's microservice development and deployment pipeline.

In addition to my industry experience, I had over two years of research experience in deep learning and computer vision. One of my works was accepted to ICCV 2023, where I contributed to the method design and took charge of development of the model architecture using PyTorch.

Interests:
- Backend Development
- Distributed Systems & Infrastructure
- Cloud Computing
- Deep Learning & Computer Vision

Familiar with following programing languages:
C++, Python, Java, SQL, JavaScript, PHP, HTML/CSS

Skilled at:
Git, Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, Spring boot, Flask, AWS, GCP, Snowflake, Spark, PyTorch, CUDA

positions.description:
- Redesigned the algorithm of a tool for tracking and analyzing abnormal products, resolving three critical logic issues that previously led to missing data.
- Optimized a data processing workflow by improving two bottleneck queries, contributing to a 86% run time reduction.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Led a team of two interns in developing a full-stack cloud-native web application on GCP, employing microservice architecture and utilizing Kubernetes and Dapr (an open-source tool) to manage internal Docker containers.
- Designed the front-end to display real-time stock market information and the back-end to crawl data from official sites, provide further data analysis for each stock, and interact with the Redis database.
- Validated the feasibility of integrating Dapr into the company's software services and utilizing Dapr to optimize the microservice development and deployment pipeline.
